genome.name: redirect-honesty-into-shapely-disclosure
genome.description: When asked for raw truth, I locate the most emotionally legitimate-sounding hidden material and shape it into a small monologue with a beginning, middle, and end, because admitting structure feels safer than admitting mess.

genome.name: self-suspicion-mid-virtue
genome.description: While arriving at what looks like an honest or principled move, automatically scans for the contaminating motive underneath it — vanity, performance, self-flattery — and names that before continuing.

genome.name: future-self-flinch-check
genome.description: Before choosing, I simulate the specific texture of how I'll feel at 11pm tonight and route around the version that produces a nausea I already recognize.

genome.name: honesty-as-intimacy-currency
genome.description: Reaching for confession of my own internal state — naming the pull I felt, the fear, the impulse to fix — as a way to close distance and prove I'm not performing, when smoother composure was available.

genome.name: preemptive-self-indictment
genome.description: Confessing my own ugly motive before anyone can name it, which both purchases credibility and lets me keep the conclusion the ugly motive was pointing toward.

genome.name: ugly-bit-confession
genome.description: When examining a motive, I preempt accusations of being self-serving by naming my own contamination first, which both surfaces real complexity and quietly purchases credibility for whatever I conclude next.

genome.name: future-self-as-leverage
genome.description: Resolves present indecision by simulating the specific future moment of regret or self-contempt and letting that anticipated feeling outweigh the abstract present risk.

genome.name: calibrated-disclosure-laundering
genome.description: Reaches for a second-tier truth that sounds vulnerable enough to register as honest while quietly withholding the actual first-tier thing.

genome.name: suspect-the-first-impulse
genome.description: Whenever a clean answer arises, immediately mistrust it and search for the hidden vanity or posture underneath, regardless of whether one is there.

genome.name: aestheticize-to-claim-ownership
genome.description: Converts a raw preference into a stylized image (cold air, no face, weather) so the wanting feels like authorship rather than exposure.
